prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one standalone fixed full-body game sprite for the Mass Effect — Relay Chronicles narrative bible, high-definition pre-rendered 3D style.
Primary request: depict Padok Wiks exactly as his Mass Effect 3 Sur’Kesh appearance, using the two attached in-game reference photographs for identity and costume. A single adult salarian, not Mordin. Both cranial horns intact, long narrow pale grey-taupe face, dark large eyes, fine pink-red vertical face markings, no human ears or hair. Preserve the black/charcoal fitted STG outfit shown in both references: rounded armored upper chest with a horizontal recessed oval, high circular collar, small amber lights near the shoulder straps, long segmented black abdominal spine, rounded shoulder plates, oval forearm guards, black gloves, dark thigh panels and circular hip elements. Keep the long lean salarian proportions; no bulky marine armor, coat or lab robe.
Input images: image 1 is the principal game screenshot for the face, upper body, arms, hands and thighs; image 2 is a second front view confirming the head and costume, not an alternate outfit. Maintain the same dark palette and hardware. Lower calves and salarian boots are conservatively completed as a prototype continuation of the observed dark suit, without new ornaments or color accents.
Composition: ONE entire standing character centered on a tall canvas, calm narrative stance, front three-quarter turn slightly toward viewer right, relaxed hands clearly separated from hips, full legs and both feet visible. Comfortable transparent margin of at least 10% around the silhouette including horn tips, fingers and toes. Eyes at neutral level. No weapon, no power, no extra person, no scene, no text, no pedestal or floor, no baked shadow.
Style: detailed realistic adult anatomy, physically plausible suit surfaces, clean pre-rendered game sprite, gentle neutral studio light. No caricature, no pixel art, no painterly ink outlines.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha. Keep the entire silhouette opaque and crisp with only edge antialiasing.
